create_mesh_from_catalog: create a Mesh from a named catalog entry using create_mesh with the mesh name and optional device
load_mesh_vertices_and_faces: load mesh vertices or faces from a pickle file using load_mesh_data with the file path and field name
load_mesh_auxiliary_data: load mesh auxiliary data like geodesic distances or texcoords from a pickle file using load_mesh_auxiliary_data
load_mesh_symmetry: load mesh symmetry vertex transforms from a pickle file using load_mesh_symmetry with LRU caching
transfer_mesh_to_device: transfer a Mesh and all its tensors to a new device using the Mesh to method
